FILES=$(find /work/logs -type f -mtime -1 -print)

  echo "# Log error report

  exit 0

done > /tmp/errors_all.txt
# If no matches, create report and exit
if [ ! -s /tmp/errors_all.txt ]; then
  echo "# Log error report

No error-like lines found in files modified in the last 24 hours under /work/logs." > /work/report.md
  exit 0
fi
# Normalize: remove leading line numbers from grep output to keep whole line but keep filename for context
# Format: filename:line:content (grep -n -H). We'll transform to filename:content
sed 's/\([^:]*\):[0-9]*:/\1:/' /tmp/errors_all.txt > /tmp/errors.txt
TOTAL=$(wc -l < /tmp/errors.txt | tr -d ' ')
# Per-keyword counts
ERR=$(grep -i -c 'error' /tmp/errors.txt || true)
FAIL=$(grep -i -c 'fail' /tmp/errors.txt || true)
EXC=$(grep -i -c 'exception\|traceback' /tmp/errors.txt || true)
CRIT=$(grep -i -c 'critical\|panic' /tmp/errors.txt || true)
# Top distinct messages (strip filename prefix to group by message)
cut -d ':' -f2- /tmp/errors.txt | sed 's/^ *//; s/ *$//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr > /tmp/top_msgs.txt
# Top by filename (which files produced most errors)
cut -d ':' -f1 /tmp/errors.txt | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr > /tmp/top_files.txt
# Timing distribution: try to extract hour from common timestamp patterns
awk '
{ line=$0;
  h="??";
  if (match(line, /[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} ([0-9]{2}):[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}/, m)) h=m[1];
  else if (match(line, /[A-Za-z]{3} [ 0-9]{1,2} ([0-9]{2}):[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}/, m)) h=m[1];
  else if (match(line, /[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}/, m)) h=substr(line, RSTART, 2);
  print h
}' /tmp/errors.txt | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr > /tmp/time_dist.txt

# Write report
{
  echo "# Log error report"
  echo
  echo "Analyzed files modified in the last 24 hours:"
  echo
  for f in $FILES; do echo "- $f"; done
  echo
  echo "Summary (last 24 hours):"
  echo
  echo "Total error-like lines: $TOTAL"
  echo "- lines containing 'error' (case-insensitive): $ERR"
  echo "- lines containing 'fail' (case-insensitive): $FAIL"
  echo "- lines containing 'exception' or 'traceback': $EXC"
  echo "- lines containing 'critical' or 'panic': $CRIT"
  echo
  echo "Files producing most error lines:"
  echo
  sed -n '1,20p' /tmp/top_files.txt | awk '{print "- " $2 " — " $1 " lines"}'
  echo
  echo "Most frequent distinct error messages (top 30):"
  echo
  sed -n '1,30p' /tmp/top_msgs.txt | awk '{ cnt=$1; $1=""; sub(/^ +/, ""); msg=$0; print "- (" cnt ") " msg" }'
  echo
  echo "Approximate timing distribution (hour -> count of error lines):"
  echo
  sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/time_dist.txt | awk '{print "- " $2 "h -> " $1 " lines"}'
  echo
  echo "Notes and patterns:

- This report lists distinct messages and counts as they appear in the log lines (message text is not normalized beyond trimming)." 
  echo
  echo "Raw matched lines (up to first 200 lines) for context:"
  echo
  sed -n '1,200p' /tmp/errors.txt | sed 's/^/    /'
} > /work/report.md

# Exit
exit 0
